prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create an exceptionally polished, realistic desktop SaaS application interface design for Wisesama, a security-response platform for small software teams. This is COMPOSITION A, "Response desk": a landscape presentation board containing TWO FULL DESKTOP APP SCREENSHOTS stacked vertically, one DARK MODE above and the exact same layout in LIGHT MODE below. Each app screenshot is 1440 by 800 proportions; total board about 1600 by 1900, white 30px margin between. Screen chrome labels outside say "A — Response desk" and "Dark" / "Light". No laptop frames or physical devices.
The attached image is the incumbent Wisesama site. It supplies ONLY brand identity: existing purple geometric mark / WISESAMA wordmark, Satoshi-like clean type, Clash Display-like headings, purple #7c3aed and pink #e6007a accents, dark charcoal warmth. DO NOT reuse the crypto marketing content, hero layout, metric cards, gradients or unsupported claims.
Application layout: 210px left navigation with small existing Wisesama mark/wordmark, workspace switcher "Acme / Engineering", menu "Overview", selected "Response inbox" with count 3, "Projects", "Briefings", "Notifications", bottom "Settings" and user "Alex Morgan". Top bar search "Search CVEs, packages, projects" and theme toggle. Main heading "Response inbox" 30px, subtitle "Know what affects your software. Follow it through to a fix." Upper right subtle outline "Import inventory" and solid purple "Add project". Thin inline summary "3 need attention · 2 projects · Last checked 8 min ago", no metric cards or charts. Small discrete pill "Demo workspace".
Main working region is a master/detail split 58%/42%. Left list tabs "Needs action 3", "In progress 1", "Resolved 8". Search/filter row with "All projects" and "Severity". Spacious but operational rows, 4 visible items with exact text:
"Brotli decoder memory corruption", identifier "CVE-2026-111497", package line "node · 22.23.3 · production-api", label "High", independent neutral label "Exploitation unknown", new purple dot and "8 min ago"; selected row slight purple-tinted background.
"PHP runtime remote code execution", identifier "CVE-2026-109618", "php · 8.3.35 · legacy-checkout", label "Critical", "Investigate".
"Next.js advisory", "Awaiting inventory confirmation", "marketing-web", label "Needs assessment".
Do not invent specific third CVE. Bottom list tiny text "Showing demonstration data. Connect your first project for live results."
Right detail inspector: small heading "Why this matches", exact readable rows "Project production-api", "Environment Production", "Installed Node.js 22.23.3", "Fixed release 22.23.4", "Inventory collected 8 min ago". Independent status chips "High severity" and "Exploit evidence unknown". Brief clear paragraph "Your imported inventory contains an affected runtime version. Confirm the version running in production." Compact action area "Next step" then "Upgrade the runtime, redeploy, and confirm the deployed version." button "Start investigation", secondary "View vendor advisory ↗". Lower neat section "Response" status dropdown "Open", note field "Add findings or verification evidence…" and action "Save update". A "Guidance updates" section with 3 timestamped lines "Patch available", "Provider guidance updated", "Inventory matched". Entire surface fits with no cropped controls.
Dark theme: #0c0c11 canvas, #121219 sidebar, #17171f secondary fields, #292833 separators, warm white primary text, #aaa5b8 secondary, vivid but restrained purple primary action. Light theme: #f8f7fa canvas, pure white content, #f0edf5 sidebar, dark #211d2a text, #6f647d secondary, purple unchanged but AA contrast. Red amber reserved strictly severity. Hairline separators, 8-12px corners, crisp thin line icons, typography hierarchy excellent, consistent 8px spacing, accurate professional UI not a neon cyberpunk dashboard. No decorative charts, no stock photos, no testimonials, no invented protection metrics. Render text sharply and plausibly.
approvalScope: Response desk functional foundation, with the subsequent requested Mobbin workflow corrections retained.
